findings: BgSvgLayer ignores prefers-reduced-motion — All 47 animated elements in BgSvgLayer use inline style={{ animation: ... }}, which CSS media queries cannot override. Users with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce will see continuous animation. Move animation to CSS classes inside the existing @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) guard in GlobalBackground.css, pass --dur as a CSS custom property, and remove the inline style attributes.
Duplicate floatY keyframe — floatY is defined identically in both index.css and GlobalBackground.css. Remove the definition from GlobalBackground.css and rely on the single declaration in index.css.

SVG overflow: visible on fixed-position layer — .global-bg-svg sets overflow: visible; particle radii at the viewbox edge (e.g. cx=3, r=1.5) can render 1–2 px outside the SVG bounding box on some browsers. Clamp all coordinates to [3, 97] or switch the SVG element to overflow: hidden.
